definitions.explanation: Pepper as a seasoning, especially black or white pepper. Loanword from English; appears mostly in cooking product names and compounds, while {胡椒|こしょう} is the everyday word.

examples.japanese: ペッパー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
ブラックペッパー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挽|ひ}いて→挽く：12794_hiku⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Grind some black pepper and sprinkle it on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ペッパー⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シンプル→シンプル：10943_shinpuru⟧な⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦のよ→のよ：30249_noyo⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}たせる→引き立つ：25243_hikitatsu⟧。
examples.english: A simple seasoning of just salt and pepper brings out the quality of the ingredients.

notes:
ペッパー sounds more modern/Western than ⟦{胡椒|こしょう}→胡椒：10321_koshou⟧ and is favored in product names, restaurant menus, and recipes with a Western feel. In daily speech, most cooks still say ⟦{胡椒|こしょう}→胡椒：10321_koshou⟧.

COMPOUNDS:
- ブラックペッパー: black pepper
- ホワイトペッパー: white pepper
- ⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧ペッパー: lemon pepper
- ペッパーミル: pepper mill

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{胡椒|こしょう}→胡椒：10321_koshou⟧: pepper — the everyday word in Japanese
- ⟦{唐辛子|とうがらし}→唐辛子：11871_tougarashi⟧: chili pepper — unrelated; a separate spice
- ⟦スパイス→スパイス：11054_supaisu⟧: spices — broad category that includes pepper
